# `CoderMCPServer`

## API identity

- Group/version: `coder.com/v1alpha1`
- Kind: `CoderMCPServer`
- Resource: `codermcpservers`
- Scope: namespaced

## Spec

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `controlPlaneRef` | [CoderControlPlaneReference](#codercontrolplanereference) | ControlPlaneRef names the CoderControlPlane in the same namespace. The controller calls Coder with that control plane's operator token. |
| `organization` | string | Organization is the name of the Coder organization that holds the config. Coder cannot move a config to another organization. Coder reserves the names new and create. |
| `slug` | string | Slug is the Coder slug of the config, unique in its organization. The model sees the server's tools as `<slug>__<tool>`. |
| `displayName` | string | DisplayName is the name that Coder shows to users in chat. |
| `description` | string | Description is a short summary of what the server provides. |
| `iconURL` | string | IconURL is the icon URL, path or emoji that Coder shows. |
| `url` | string | URL is the http:// or https:// MCP endpoint that Coder connects to. It must not hold user info. Every Secret in auth must list its origin as an allowed destination. |
| `transport` | string | Transport is the MCP transport that Coder uses. |
| `availability` | string | Availability decides how chats offer the server. force_on adds it to every new chat of a user who can read it. Coder's web UI preselects default_on servers. The Coder server treats default_on and default_off alike. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Enabled turns the server on or off in Coder. Chats never connect to a disabled server. When omitted, the default is true. |
| `allowInPlanMode` | boolean | AllowInPlanMode offers the server in plan-mode chats. |
| `modelIntent` | boolean | ModelIntent asks the model to state its intent with each tool call. |
| `forwardCoderHeaders` | boolean | ForwardCoderHeaders sends the chat owner, chat and workspace IDs to the server as X-Coder-* headers. Coder sends no token in them. |
| `auth` | [CoderMCPServerAuth](#codermcpserverauth) | Auth is how Coder authenticates to the server. |
| `access` | [CoderMCPServerAccess](#codermcpserveraccess) | Access, when set, makes the controller own the server's access list in Coder: exactly the listed groups can read the server. Every sync therefore also removes each user entry, for example a user that an admin added in the Coder dashboard. Coder does not show the entry of a deleted group, so the sync cannot remove it, but it grants nothing. When omitted, the controller leaves the access list alone, and Coder's default lets every organization member read the server. |

## Status

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | ObservedGeneration is the generation the controller last processed. |
| `appliedGeneration` | integer | AppliedGeneration is the last generation whose spec Coder fully holds, or that a kill switch holds: when the controller disables the config because a credential Secret or the control plane withdrew consent, it sets this field before it sends the disable, so only a later spec edit enables the config again. Ready tells whether Coder holds the spec. |
| `organizationID` | string | OrganizationID is the Coder organization ID that spec.organization resolved to first. |
| `configID` | string | ConfigID is the Coder MCP server config ID. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Enabled is the enabled flag of the Coder MCP server config at the controller's last read or update of it. It is empty while Coder holds no config of this object, or before the first read. |
| `createAttemptTime` | [Time](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.35/#time-v1-meta) | CreateAttemptTime is set before every create request. While it is set and ConfigID is empty, a create request can be in flight or already committed in Coder. |
| `credentials` | [CoderMCPServerCredentialStatus](#codermcpservercredentialstatus) array | Credentials record the Secret values last sent to Coder. |
| `conditions` | [Condition](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.35/#condition-v1-meta) array | Conditions are Ready, Reconciling, and Stalled. |

### CoderMCPServerAPIKeyAuth

CoderMCPServerAPIKeyAuth sends one Secret value in one header. Coder sends
the value as it is, so a bearer token is stored as `Bearer <token>`.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | string | Header is the HTTP header name. |

### CoderMCPServerAccess

CoderMCPServerAccess lists the Coder groups that can read the server.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `groups` | string array | Groups are Coder group names in the server's organization. Everyone is the group of all organization members. An empty list leaves the server to organization admins. Coder reserves the names new and create. While a listed group does not exist, the controller removes the access of every group that this list does not name, adds none, disables the server if the spec disables it, and waits with GroupNotFound for the rest. |

### CoderMCPServerAuth

CoderMCPServerAuth is how Coder authenticates to the MCP server. Exactly
the block that matches type is set.
+kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="(self.type == 'api_key') == has(self.apiKey)",message="auth.apiKey must be set exactly when auth.type is api_key"
+kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="(self.type == 'custom_headers') == has(self.customHeaders)",message="auth.customHeaders must be set exactly when auth.type is custom_headers"
+kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="(self.type == 'oauth2') == has(self.oauth2)",message="auth.oauth2 must be set exactly when auth.type is oauth2"

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | Type is the auth type. Coder's user_oidc type is not supported, because it sends each user's login token to the server URL. |
| `apiKey` | [CoderMCPServerAPIKeyAuth](#codermcpserverapikeyauth) | APIKey sends one Secret value in one header. |
| `customHeaders` | [CoderMCPServerHeader](#codermcpserverheader) array | CustomHeaders sends each Secret value in its own header. |
| `oauth2` | [CoderMCPServerOAuth2Auth](#codermcpserveroauth2auth) | OAuth2 lets each user connect with an OAuth2 client that the admin registered at the authorization server. |

### CoderMCPServerOAuth2Auth

CoderMCPServerOAuth2Auth is a manually registered OAuth2 client. Coder's
automatic discovery and dynamic client registration are not supported.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clientID` | string | ClientID is the OAuth2 client ID. |
| `clientSecretRef` | [SecretKeySelector](#secretkeyselector) | ClientSecretRef references the key in a Secret in the same namespace that holds the client secret. The Secret must opt in to the credential Secret contract and list the origins of spec.url, authURL, tokenURL and revocationURL. |
| `authURL` | string | AuthURL is the authorization endpoint that users' browsers open. |
| `tokenURL` | string | TokenURL is the token endpoint that Coder sends the client secret to. |
| `revocationURL` | string | RevocationURL is the https:// token revocation endpoint. Coder sends the client secret there when a user disconnects. |
| `scopes` | string array | Scopes are the OAuth2 scopes that Coder requests. |
